name: wind chimes
role: Three craftable wind chimes with native Sable motion response and interaction sounds.
native_route_note: Original archive embeds sable-companion-common-1.21.1 1.6.0, byte-identical to the library embedded by Sable 2.0.6. Three ordinary vanilla-resource crafting recipes. Both physical sides retain windchimes saved block IDs; graphical and ship behavior acceptance pending.

name: Shoulder Surfing Reloaded
role: Side-offset third-person camera with the retained Otherworld framing; ordinary first person and player-origin interaction reach retained.
native_route_note: Sable 2.0.6 targets the 4.x internal API, absent in 5.2.0. Owned exact-version adapter skips the redundant zero-sway rotation to avoid applying ship orientation twice. Retained Otherworld framing is -0.725/0.025/3.3; movement stays coupled and player FOV is inherited. Graphical/ship acceptance pending. Native runtime metadata version is 1.21.1-4.22.12. Both native sway amplitudes are explicitly pinned to zero in fresh-profile defaults; enabling sway retains upstream behavior and needs separate ship review.

name: Polytone

license.name: GNU General Public License v3.0 or later

role: Resource-driven vanilla sky palette and restrained star mesh; existing cloud, horizon and shader renderers retained.
native_route_note: Actual native descriptor and LICENSE_Polytone.md declare Supplementaries Team License 1.5, differing from the GPL provider label. Section 5 allows unmodified official-download modpack references; no direct binary bundling. No extra mandatory native libraries. Two owned JSONs adjust biome-preserving sky/sunrise colors and vanilla star count/size without replacing clouds, dimension effects or horizon. Critical current NeoForge/Sodium/Iris APIs inspected; client acceptance pending. Native root polytone_options.json disables unrelated player-light interpolation and the colored-light backend. Shaderless lead rendering retains the provider vanilla-brown texture. Exact dimension/color codecs and v/g.dayTime/r.rand()/TAU expression functions were inspected.
